title: Sandy Pines Campground

services.name: Rv & Tent Sites
services.desc: This is your opportunity to enjoy Sandy Pines Campground’s amenities all season in one of our spacious, luxurious park models currently for sale. This is by far the most affordable way to have a summer home in Kennebunkport. Models vary in layout and style, but all feature full kitchens, bathrooms with showers, a separate bedroom, living rooms, and screened porches. Come be a part of our extended family while creating priceless memories for your family! This park model located in the desirable town of Kennebunkport includes a kitchen with dining area, living room, master bedroom, bathroom, enclosed porch, and open front porch. Price does not include annual site fee. Subleasing not

blurb: Camping at Sandy Pines Campground offers a relaxing respite in a tranquil part of coastal Kennebunkport, Maine. Glamping tents and structures, as well as tent and RV sites, are tucked into a secluded beach forest, bordered by a salt marsh, and enhanced by water views and salty breezes.
